Page 43 Cont. Aug. 4 Mariyn Pletz - 6 - pneumonia - 3 other little children ... Thomas Franek - again 1'

3 Eileen F. T. Hyland - 24 - of Cleveland, 0. - Epyleptic Early Child. here To-day and Enrolled perpetually ...
4 Albert Bauman - 2 - Sort of paralysis since 6 month old. Recently gone totally blind. Father not cath.
6 Thanks - Baby Robert W. Saydak - Born June 11 with "water on brain" ... when enrolled in "Ser. Masses" on July 23rd the head girt was 174 inches. To-day reported 14 { inches. Dr's say "phenominal", home now and every hope - will be normal, Deo Gr .!
Page 44
Aug. 8 Thanks - C. Umlaug - 52 - almost blind - one eye totally gone. - phone Vinewood 21295 - Enrolled in Ser. Masses - in early spring ... Eyes just fine now.
9 Geo Dunning - 26 - Very remarkable ailment. Drs find it difficult to say just what may be the trouble. He is very defective in use of hands and feet. Asked if he ever received the Sacraments, he acknowledged, he'd never been baptized .... Enrolled To-day perpet- ually .....
Mrs. Eliz. Beaubien - 55 - Palsey and hardening of arteries ....
10 Jack Lang - 25 -Soldier Chanuted Field - broken back - hyked into Camp.
11 Anthony Melchin 4- Infantile P. and spinal maningitis now ten days. This child also has a sister 3 yr. old has been invalid since born. .. Boy enrolled Today 50c
12 Fr. Pelowski - 47 - drinking to excess almost every pay-day. Uses foul, filthy language before his children ....
Page 45 Aug. 12 Wm. Whitney - 58- operation for bowel obstruction June 26 and again two weeks later Second time however was for appendicitis. Enrolled To-day in Ser. Mass Assoc'n
12 Thanks - Mrs. J. Trombley - 52 of 3616 Beaconsfield - for 17 yrs. spinal paralysis, came to the blessing here for 9 Wednesdays and To-day reports "perfectly cured". Thank God.
